GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_YUE_GUANG_GU.det:
The entry point of the Moon branch and the source of the companion card [gold]Moonblade[/gold].
Activate: costs 1 Yuan Qi; only 1 activation per entry into Active Gu.
Cooldown: enters Gu Cooldown for 2 turns, then joins Gu Waiting and refills empty Active Gu slots in order.
Scaling: the rank window is rank 1 only, so direct damage is a flat 2 — a Gu never carries the main action; the payoff lives in Moonblade's refraction segment.
Activation buff: every activation stacks 1 [gold]Moon Lustre[/gold] on Moonblade (each stack adds 2 to its refraction damage, up to 3 stacks, at most 3 triggers per combat).
Companion: each Moonlight Gu brings 3 Moonblades into the permanent deck (2 starter copies → 6 Moonblades); if it is consumed as a [gold]fusion[/gold] material, those Moonblades are lost with it.
Acquisition: 2 copies in the starting deck; also from card rewards.
Fusion: Moonlight Gu + Jade Skin Gu → [gold]Moon Nimbus Gu[/gold].

GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_YU_PI_GU.detailD:

Cooldown: enters Gu Cooldown for 2 turns.
Scaling: the rank window is rank 1 only, so direct Block is a flat 2.
Activation buff: every activation stacks 1 hardening on Jade Skin Armor (3 Block per stack, up to 3 stacks, at most 3 triggers per combat). Jade Skin Armor has no refraction segment, so this buff is never multiplied by Focus.
Companion: each Jade Skin Gu brings 3 Jade Skin Armors into the permanent deck (1 starter copy → 3); if it is consumed as a [gold]fusion[/gold] material, those armors are lost with it.
Acquisition: 1 copy in the starting deck; also from card rewards.
Fusion: Moonlight Gu + Jade Skin Gu → [gold]Moon Nimbus Gu[/gold].

GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_HUI_GUANG_GU.det:
The entry point of the Light Dao main line; it brings 2 copies of [gold]Radiant Arrow[/gold] and provides low-rank attack density while teaching refraction.
Activate: costs 1 Yuan Qi; only 1 activation per entry into Active Gu.
Cooldown: enters Gu Cooldown for 2 turns.
Rank window: 1–2; direct damage = rank (1 at rank 1, 2 at rank 2).
Activation buff: each Radiant Arrow gains [gold]Radiance[/gold] equal to this Gu's rank (each stack adds 1 refraction damage, up to 2 stacks, at most 2 triggers per copy per combat).
Rank-up: Radiant Gu rank 1 → rank 2.
Fusion: Radiant Gu + Dazzling Gu (both rank 2+) → [gold]Light Rainbow Gu[/gold].

A Light Dao reward-pool Gu; it brings 1 [gold]Returning Light[/gold] and handles attack recovery and the attack-skill-attack chain.
Activate: costs 1 Yuan Qi; only 1 activation per entry into Active Gu.
Cooldown: enters Gu Cooldown for 3 turns (1 turn longer than a regular Gu).
Rank window: 2–4.
Activation buff [gold]Returning Light[/gold]: at rank 2 it triggers once this combat and reduces the recovered card's cost by 1; at rank 3 it triggers twice at −1 each; at rank 4 it triggers twice and makes the recovered card cost 0 this turn.
Note: Returning Light's own refraction is the pure-function recovery, so this discount is never copied by Focus and never makes the recovery itself spend Focus — which keeps the infinite-loop risk low.
Fusion: Bright Moon Nimbus Gu + Returning Light Gu (both rank 3+) → [gold]Treasured Moon Nimbus Gu[/gold].
Acquisition: card rewards.

GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_JU_GUANG_GU.deta:
A fusion result Gu; it cannot be obtained directly and never appears in card rewards. It brings 1 [gold]Focus Mirror[/gold].
Recipes: Light Rainbow Gu + Light Source Gu (both materials need rank 3 or higher).
Fusion: pick [gold]Fusion[/gold] at a rest site; the result rank = highest material rank + 1 = 4.
Activate: costs 2 Yuan Qi; only 1 activation per entry into Active Gu.
Cooldown: enters Gu Cooldown for 3 turns.
Rank window: 4.
Activation buff [gold]Converging Light[/gold]: Focus Mirror's first 2 refractions this combat each grant 1 extra Focus, so each of them yields 2 Focus in total. Focus Mirror's own refraction is the pure-function Focus gain: it spends no existing Focus and is never repeated by Focus.
Role: instead of adding a number to the next refraction, Focus Gu actively prepares extra resolution chances for later numeric cards — up to 2 extra repetitions.
Note: consuming Light Rainbow Gu and Light Source Gu also removes their companion cards.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_TAI_GUANG_GU.des:

GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_TAI_GUANG_GU.det:
A fusion result Gu; it cannot be obtained directly and never appears in card rewards. It brings 1 [gold]Great Light Lance[/gold].
Recipes: Dazzling Gu + Borrowed Light Gu (both materials need rank 4 or higher).
Fusion: pick [gold]Fusion[/gold] at a rest site; the result rank = highest material rank + 1 = 5.
Activate: costs 2 Yuan Qi; only 1 activation per entry into Active Gu.
Cooldown: enters Gu Cooldown for 3 turns.
Rank window: 5.
Activation buff [gold]Great Illumination[/gold]: Great Light Lance gains 1 use; if its next refraction is repeated by Focus, the second (repeated) refraction deals 4 extra damage — applied only on the repeated pass.
So the buffed burst is 8 base + 6 first refraction + 10 repeated refraction = 24 damage.
Intent: Great Light Gu no longer creates repetition itself; it rewards preparing Focus first and then spending the repetition on a high-quality refraction.
Note: consuming Dazzling Gu and Borrowed Light Gu also removes their companion cards.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_HENG_GUANG_XIAN_:
[blue]Rank {Rank}[/blue] · [gold]Fusion[/gold] · [gold]Cooldown[/gold] [blue]{RecoveryTurns}[/blue]
Both companions gain [gold]Eternal Radiance[/gold]: when a refraction is repeated by Focus, gain [blue]1[/blue] Focus after the repeat and make the next card with a refraction segment refract unconditionally. [blue]1/2/3[/blue] uses at ranks 6/7/8.

A fusion result Gu (an immortal Gu); it cannot be obtained directly and never appears in card rewards. It brings 1 [gold]Eternal Light Blade[/gold] and 1 [gold]Eternal Light Ward[/gold].
Recipes: Great Light Gu + Treasured Moonlight King Gu (both materials need rank 5 or higher).
Fusion: pick [gold]Fusion[/gold] at a rest site; the result rank = highest material rank + 1 = 6, then advanced to ranks 7 and 8 by rank-up.
Activate: costs 2 Yuan Qi; only 1 activation per entry into Active Gu; rank 6+ costs extra Immortal Essence.
Cooldown: enters Gu Cooldown for 3 turns.
Rank window: 6–8.
Scaling: Eternal Light Blade's damage / Eternal Light Ward's Block = rank + 2 (8/9/10 at ranks 6/7/8); their refraction values = rank − 1 (5/6/7 at ranks 6/7/8).
Activation buff [gold]Eternal Radiance[/gold]: each companion gains a rank-scaled number of uses — 1 at rank 6, 2 at rank 7, 3 at rank 8. If the card's refraction is repeated by Focus, it grants 1 Focus after the repeat and makes the next card with a refraction segment refract unconditionally.
Intent: carry an already-happened repetition on to the next card; the refund is bound to the Eternal Light companions and is use-limited, so it never makes the whole deck repeat for free forever.
Note: consuming Great Light Gu and Treasured Moonlight King Gu also removes their companion cards.

GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_GUANG_GU.descrip:

GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_GUANG_GU.detailD:
A rank-9 fusion result Gu (an immortal Gu); it cannot be obtained directly and never appears in card rewards. It brings 1 [gold]Light Splendor[/gold] and 1 [gold]Light Realm[/gold].
Recipes: Eternal Light Immortal Gu + Great Light Gu (both materials need rank 5 or higher).
Fusion: pick [gold]Fusion[/gold] at a rest site; this is the rank-9 endpoint, so the result rank is fixed at 9 instead of floating with the materials.
Activate: costs 3 Yuan Qi; only 1 activation per entry into Active Gu; rank 9 also costs extra Immortal Essence.
Cooldown: enters Gu Cooldown for 4 turns.
Rank window: 9.
Activation effect: this turn, every normal card with a refraction segment counts as meeting its refraction condition. Focus is still consumed one layer at a time as usual and never becomes infinite; the rank-9 advantage is aiming your limited Focus precisely at the numeric cards you want to repeat.
No extra companion buff declaration: Light Splendor and Light Realm each bring their own payoff after a repeated refraction.
Risk note: combined with 0-cost, draw and Returning Light effects it may produce extremely long turns and needs live testing.
Note: consuming Eternal Light Immortal Gu and Great Light Gu also removes their companion cards.

GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_HUI_GUANG_JIAN.d:
The permanent companion card of [gold]Radiant Gu[/gold]. It belongs to the normal card system: it uses the normal hand and draw piles, costs Energy, and supports native upgrades and enchantments — it occupies no [gold]Active Gu[/gold] or [gold]Gu Waiting[/gold] slot.
Effect: deal 5 damage; upgrading adds 3 (+3 base, 8) and 1 refraction damage (4). The cost is unchanged.
Refraction segment: deal 3 extra damage. It carries the Light Dao tag, so it refracts when the last normal card you actively played this turn is of a different type (Attack vs Skill). This is a numeric refraction: if you have [gold]Focus[/gold], 1 layer is spent and the whole segment resolves one extra time.
Binding: each Radiant Gu brings 2 separate Radiant Arrows; if the source Gu is consumed as a fusion material, those arrows are lost with it.
Acquisition: never from card rewards; only brought in by Radiant Gu.

Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
[gold]Refraction[/gold]: gain {RefractionBlock:diff()} extra Block and make the next attack card refract unconditionally.

The permanent companion card of [gold]Dazzling Gu[/gold]. It belongs to the normal card system: it uses the normal hand and draw piles, costs Energy, and supports native upgrades and enchantments.
Effect: gain 5 Block; upgrading adds 3 to base (8) and 1 to refraction (3). The cost is unchanged.
Refraction segment: gain 2 extra Block and make the next Light Dao attack card refract unconditionally. This is a numeric + functional mixed refraction: the whole segment can be repeated by Focus, but "forced refraction" is a boolean state and does not stack.
The forced-refraction mark is only consumed by the next Light Dao attack card; playing a skill card in between does not eat it.
Binding: each Dazzling Gu brings 1 Dazzling Veil; if the source Gu is consumed as a fusion material, it is lost with it.
Acquisition: never from card rewards; only brought in by Dazzling Gu.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_YIN_GUANG.title: Guiding Light
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARD_YIN_GUANG.detail:
The permanent companion card of [gold]Light Source Gu[/gold]. It belongs to the normal card system: it uses the normal hand and draw piles, costs Energy, and supports native upgrades and enchantments.
Effect: gain 4 Block; upgrading adds 3 (7). The cost is unchanged, and upgrading does not change the refraction because that segment has no numeric value.
Refraction segment: gain 1 Yuan Qi (capped by the current Yuan Qi maximum). This is a [gold]pure-function refraction[/gold]: it neither spends Focus nor gets repeated because you hold Focus.
Parent buff: activating Light Source Gu stacks a buff on Guiding Light so that its first 2 refractions this combat each gain Block equal to the Gu's rank; that Block is added value and does not turn Guiding Light into a numeric refraction.
Binding: each Light Source Gu brings 1 Guiding Light; if the source Gu is consumed as a fusion material, it is lost with it.
Acquisition: never from card rewards; only brought in by Light Source Gu.

Effect: deal 6 damage; upgrading adds 3 (9). The cost is unchanged.
Refraction segment: if your current Focus is 0, gain 1 Focus. This is a [gold]pure-function refraction[/gold] that neither spends Focus nor gets repeated.
Parent buff: after activating Borrowed Light Gu, its first 2 refractions this combat gain 1 Focus whether or not you already have any (still only 1 layer, never 2).
Binding: each Borrowed Light Gu brings 1 Borrowed Beam; if the source Gu is consumed as a fusion material, it is lost with it.
Acquisition: never from card rewards; only brought in by Borrowed Light Gu.
